R.title: Bedingung und gerichtete Bewegung
R.line37: Wenn das Gemisch warm ist, bewegt sich dieser Stoff dorthin.
R.local_syntax: The initial teeolain supplies the subject of chey qoteedy qokain. cheey resumes that same hypothetical material in the consequent cheedy cheey lchedy. The source subject precedes the condition marker; German moves it inside the if-clause. No additional finite verb or then word is inserted. lchedy keeps goal direction; destination identity remains open.
obligations: A condition is not an assertion that the mixture is warm or that motion actually occurs.
The newly chosen motion meaning fills the previous goal requirement by construction; this is not independent evidence for lchedy=dorthin.
Every cheedy keeps motion, not rest or generic becomes; all cheey keep a material anaphor with unresolved reference unless explicitly bound.
Gemisch does not identify ingredients, a preparation recipe or the same portion as earlier shedy.

T.title: Bedingung und späterer Ruhezustand
T.line37: Wenn das Gemisch warm ist, ruht dieser Stoff später.
T.local_syntax: Same subject and conditional grouping as R; cheey resumes teeolain in the consequent. lchedy remains later; the comparison time/event is not identified at37. This does not change the separate fixed26 later-than-drainage reading.
obligations: Neither warmth nor rest is asserted as an observed event; both belong to a hypothetical conditional statement.
Every cheedy retains a resting state, never covert motion at source/goal expressions.
Every cheey retains material anaphora; no globally automatic prior participant chosen.
State/effect versus motion is bundled with inherited lchedy meanings; no independent single-word ranking.

syntax_scope: One explicit complete parse at37. Other chey occurrences require full condition/consequence content; no generic lookahead/negation/carry parser is fitted. Raw physical line ends do not close a condition automatically.
selection_basis: All45 target occurrences including whole lines and explicit continuations77r20,29v3-4 were read before model selection. Gemisch, wenn, motion/rest and material anaphora are concrete exploratory choices; no primary report identifies these senses. No old check/negation/dry/result gloss used as truth.
family_debt: chey/cheey/cheedy are related-looking whole forms but their four roles have no demonstrated component mapping. GDT929/W56 cheey/sheey coexistence and GDT739 downgraded result defaults remain constraints, not meaning evidence. No free e/dy export.
retained_rivals: Q and V remain open; unextended old models and experiments unchanged.
